quote: The history of all hitherto existing society is the history of class struggles.
The proletarians have nothing to lose but their chains. They have a world to win.
Freedom is always the freedom of dissenters.
The issue of power is the fundamental issue of every revolution.
Capitalism has triumphed all over the world, but this triumph is only the prelude to the triumph of labour over capital.
work: The Three Sources and Three Component Parts of Marxism (1913)

quote: The movement will find itself on firm ground. Quantity will do it.
The emancipation of the working classes must be conquered by the working classes themselves.
work: General Rules of the International Working Men's Association (1864)

quote: Revolution with remarkable consistency drives every proposition to its logical conclusion and ruthlessly exposes the utter futility and criminality of all wrong tactics.
work: Interview Granted to an Izvestia Correspondent (1918)
